core_services.description: Terminate the run with a 32-bit exit status; a second termination request fails closed.

observable.digest_layout: fnv1a64 over: ascii 'OROBS1' | u32le image_length | image bytes | u32le register_count | each register u32le | u32le aux_count | each aux value u32le in profile order | u32le pc | u64le steps | u32le exit_status (0xffffffff when absent) | u32le external_output_length | external_output bytes

symbols.name: or_rt_memory_read
symbols.semantics: Read width_bits (8/16/32/64) at a guest address into *out_value; returns OR_RT_OK or a memory failure code; out_value must not be null.
symbols.signature: int or_rt_memory_read(uint64_t address, uint32_t width_bits, uint64_t *out_value)

symbols.name: or_rt_memory_write
symbols.semantics: Write the low width_bits of value at a guest address; returns OR_RT_OK or a memory failure code.
symbols.signature: int or_rt_memory_write(uint64_t address, uint32_t width_bits, uint64_t value)

symbols.name: or_rt_host_call
symbols.semantics: Synchronous typed service call; unknown services, wrong argument counts, version mismatches and handler failures return a stable failure code and never call undeclared host functionality.
symbols.signature: int or_rt_host_call(uint64_t service_id, uint32_t argc, const uint64_t *args, uint64_t *out_value)

symbols.name: or_rt_failure_reason
symbols.semantics: Stable, host-path-free failure name for a failure code; empty string for OR_RT_OK; bounded for unknown codes.

symbols.name: openrecomp_run
symbols.semantics: Execute the generated program from its entry state.

symbols.name: openrecomp_failed
symbols.semantics: 1 once the run latched a failure, else 0.

symbols.name: openrecomp_error
symbols.semantics: Empty string while no failure is latched; otherwise the stable failure name.

symbols.name: openrecomp_register_count
symbols.semantics: Size of the guest register file (architecture-neutral vector).

symbols.name: openrecomp_register_value
symbols.semantics: Value of guest register index; out-of-range index fails closed.

symbols.name: openrecomp_image
symbols.semantics: Start of the immutable loaded guest image.

symbols.name: openrecomp_image_size
symbols.semantics: Byte length of the loaded guest image.

symbols.name: openrecomp_region_count
symbols.semantics: Number of declared guest memory regions.

symbols.name: openrecomp_region
symbols.semantics: Region index bounds (end exclusive) and permission flags; out-of-range index fails closed.
symbols.signature: void openrecomp_region(uint32_t index, uint32_t *start, uint32_t *end, uint32_t *flags)
